definitions.explanation: A broad, general explanation or summary of a topic, covering the main points without going into great detail. Often used as a book title or section heading.

examples.english: I read an overview of Japanese literature.

notes:
USAGE:
{概説|がいせつ} is commonly used in academic contexts as a book or chapter title meaning "Introduction to" or "Survey of." The verb form {概説|がいせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to give a general explanation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {概説|がいせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to give an overview)
- {概説|がいせつ}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (an introductory book, survey text)
- 〜{概説|がいせつ} (as a title: "Survey of ~")

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{概要|がいよう}→概要：06747_gaiyou⟧: outline, summary
- ⟦{概論|がいろん}→概論：04126_gairon⟧: general introduction (as a course or book title)
- {総説|そうせつ}: review article, general review
- ⟦{入門|にゅうもん}→入門：11643_nyuumon⟧: introduction (beginner level)
